high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "amazingsciencez." The post features a grid of six photographs showing spider webs spun under the influence of different drugs. Each photograph is labeled with the name of the drug tested: Normal: A typical spider web. Chloral hydrate: A web with a more irregular pattern. Marijuana: A web with a complex, almost chaotic structure. Ecstasy: A web with a more intricate and detailed pattern. LSD: A web with a symmetrical, geometric design.
